title: App has gone rogue!
body: I've had to delete the app before it drives me insane from sending notifications every two seconds for a routine that I have finished. I even turned the phone off and on and it kept sending them. I deleted the routine  and it kept sending them. I love this app but I don't want to throw my phone against a wall. Having my garmin buzzing every two seconds with notifications is enough  to drive one insane! Please fix this!
author: ikonographics

title: Review
body: The app is so good , even the limited version is rlly helpful and I would totally recommend it .it helps you get organised and cut down on procrastination which I used to struggle with .I would just like more free routines to make
author: dorxmeli7

title: unique and truly useful idea for those with adhd but its very poorly made
body: Also the watch app, which was my primary way of using the app, wants a lot of work both visually and feature wise
author: Spyros Bazios

title: Excellent
body: I subscribed and it literally helped me organize every little detail in my life.I made many routines and as it makes you follow them till the end -without pressure- after you press start, i found myself behaving totally different.Suddenly i was the productive happy and on top of things person i always wanted and had struggled so much to be.Congratulations on your work!
author: BobakiTiou1
